{{Update |title1 =Null & Void Night 3 Update |image1 = NightIIIPromo.png |release_date = 31 October 2025 (v1.79.0) |minor_updates = v1.79.1 (1 November 2025)
v1.79.1a (9 November 2025) |feed_title = 👻 NULL & VOID - NIGHT 3 🎃 |feed_color = Green |previous_update = [[v1.78.0|Null & Void Night 2 Update]] |next_update = [[v1.80.0]] }} ==Description== '''v1.79.0''' is the one hundred and thirty-first update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 31st of October 2025. It added the [[Blind Faith|third night]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]. This update encompassed three versions, the main v1.79.0 update (released 31 October 2025) and two minor updates, the v1.79.1 (released 1 November 2025) and v1.79.1a (released 9 November 2025). ==Additions== ===Towers=== *[[Warlock]] ===Enemies=== *Modern enemies: **[[Executioner Skeleton (Null & Void)|Executioner Skeleton]] **[[Gravestone]] **[[Hallow Guard (Null & Void)|Hallow Guard]] **[[Kronus]] **[[Null Accelerator]] **[[Null Brawler]] **[[Null Engineer]] **[[Null Necromancer]] **[[Null Pursuit]] **[[Null Sentry]] **[[Rift Walker]] *Legacy enemy: **[[Hallow Guard (Trick or Threat Town)|Hallow Guard]] ===Maps=== *[[Blind Faith]] ===Miscellaneous=== *[[Kronus (Narrator)|Kronus]] *[[Ramiel]] *[[Marcellus]] *[[Lord Exo (Narrator)|Lord Exo]] *[[Damage Debuff]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *Game optimizations. *[[Harvester]] is now giftable. *[[Pursuit]] no longer has the [[Freeze Immunity]]. *Boosted {{GumDrops|Gum Drop}} dropped per wave in [[Banlands]]. **Easy increased from {{GumDrops|7}} to {{GumDrops|12}}. **Hard increased from {{GumDrops|15}} to {{GumDrops|24}}. *Decreased [[The Tower]]'s tower debuff boost from 25% to 10%. *Decreased [[The Chariot]]'s [[Firerate Debuff]] from 15% to 10%. *Decreased [[Temperance]]'s [[Mutation]] health increase from 5% to 2.5%. *Updated [[Nerd Duck (Narrator)|Nerd Duck]] narrator model. *Extended cutscene skip timers. *[[Null Guardian]] no longer applies [[Aggro]] to the [[Null Guardian Clone]]s it summons. *[[Hallow Punk]]'s gamepass no longer gives the {{Color|LunarYear|Lunar}} skin. *Curse vote no longer resets [[Time Scale]] back to 1x once it is over. *Updated [[Null Medic]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description. *Enemies affected by [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]]'s speed boost pads now emit blue particles while the boost is active. *Translucent parts of enemies and towers, such as the translucent bodies of [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies, now get highlighted when hovered. *Fixed [[Skills]] not being enabled in [[Banlands]]'s Easy difficulty. *Fixed [[Slasher]] gifting not working. *Fixed {{Color|Null|Ghost}} [[Demoman]] skin not having any animations. *Fixed [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]] enemies having a placeholder icon in the [[Index]]. *Fixed [[Null Guardian]] and [[Null Guardian Clone]] not having a [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description. *Fixed [[Null Guardian]]'s model not loading in the [[Index]]. *Fixed [[Balloon Kid]] not having a proper hover hitbox, though the one added is quite small. :In '''v1.79.1''': *[[Rift Walker]] no longer becomes immune to damage during its ''Lord Exo Attack'' ability. *Fixed some animations not playing in [[Blind Faith]]. :In '''v1.79.1a''': *Fixed legacy [[Hallow Guard (Trick or Threat Town)|Hallow Guard]] not having any walk animations.
